notes: The selected Q4-FP16 artifact is fetched deterministically by scripts/fetch_pronunciation_model.py, verified by size and SHA-256, and copied into the iOS bundle at build time. It is intentionally not stored in Git. The production C++ OnnxAcousticModel maps the model's 392 eSpeak CTC labels into the engine's compact 40-phoneme inventory plus a conservative blank/unsupported bucket.

rejectedArtifact.rejectedBecause: 38.0% larger, 20.3% more portable peak process RSS, 15.7% slower median / 23.9% slower p95 inference, and lower FP32-parity accuracy than Q4-FP16 in the 2026-09-28 benchmark

runtime.note: CPU-first launch integration: ONNX Runtime mobile guidance recommends starting with CPU for quantized models. Core ML remains a device parity/performance gate before enabling it.

checksum.note: Verified by scripts/fetch_pronunciation_model.py before the model is copied into the app bundle.
